{
  "summary": "Updates the scanblocks RPC to throw an error when reading block filters fails instead of silently ignoring the failure. The RPC now returns a 'still in the process of being indexed' error if the block filter index has not caught up to the chain tip, and an internal error if the index is already synced.",
  "problem": "When scanblocks queries a block range that has not yet been indexed—such as right after startup while the block filter index catches up in the background—LookupFilterRange fails. The RPC ignored the failure, advanced the block pointer past the chunk, and returned a completed status with an incomplete match list, leaving callers unable to tell whether blocks had no matches or were simply skipped.",
  "evidence": [
    "PR description: 'The result is a silent gap: a caller gets a relevant_blocks list that looks fine but is missing any match in the unindexed range, with no way to distinguish \"no matches\" from \"range was never scanned\".'",
    "Diff in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp shows LookupFilterRange failure previously had no error handling branch and fell through to start_index = end_range."
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "depends_on": [],
    "enables": []

  "card": "Throws an RPC error in scanblocks when reading a block filter range fails, rather than silently skipping the affected chunk and reporting completed: true. When the block filter index is still syncing behind the active chain tip, callers touching unindexed blocks previously received partial results that silently omitted matching transactions. The RPC now returns an indexing-in-progress error if the index has not finished syncing or an internal error if already synced, matching getblockfilter behavior.",

result.card: Throws an RPC error in scanblocks when reading a block filter range fails, rather than silently skipping the affected chunk and reporting completed: true. When the block filter index is still syncing behind the active chain tip, callers touching unindexed blocks previously received partial results that silently omitted matching transactions. The RPC now returns an indexing-in-progress error if the index has not finished syncing or an internal error if already synced, matching getblockfilter behavior.
